text:
alex: quick sanity check — i'm going to change the sidecar ConfigMap path in the staging overlay so the log-rotation config lives under `overlays/staging/services/webapp/sidecar-config.yaml` instead of the flattened `overlays/staging/configs/`. planning to push as a terraform update to k8s_config_map.resource. want to catch any secrets/serviceaccount path coupling before promote to prod.

maria: sounds fine, what's the tf plan diff going to look like? any name changes or just path ref updates?

alex: just the `data` key ref and the metadata/labels are the same. terraform will replace the k8s_config_map resource because we change `metadata[0].name` -> actually leaving name, only `binary_data`/`data` contents pathing. but k8s provider may trigger replace on some fields. plan snippet:
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_config_map" "sidecar" {
  metadata {
    name = "webapp-sidecar-config"
    namespace = var.namespace
    labels = { app = "webapp" }
  }
  data = {
    "log-rotation.conf" = file("${path.module}/../overlays/staging/services/webapp/sidecar-config.yaml")
  }
}
```

chris: if tf wants to replace the ConfigMap, our deployment uses `spec.template.metadata.annotations` to trigger pod rollouts on config change? we rely on a checksum annotation in k8s manifest — is that hooked up for this overlay?

alex: yes, we already have `configmap-checksum` annotation in the kustomize base patch. overlay will still apply the checksum via kustomize transformer. i ran a local `kubectl apply --dry-run=server` against the staging cluster to validate shape.

priya: can you paste the `kubectl` command you used? i want to run the same quick check in my account.

alex: sure —
```bash
kubectl apply -f deploy/staging/webapp/kustomized.yaml --server-dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl --context staging-debug get -f - --namespace webapp --dry-run=server -o yaml
```
It returned the updated configmap and no apiVersion issues.

jenna: heads up — secrets wiring: do we reference any secret keys by path name from the sidecar config? if so, moving the file path won't change the key names inside the ConfigMap, but double-check any docs or scripts that `cat` the config from a specific file path at runtime.

alex: good catch — the sidecar init script reads `/etc/sidecar/conf/log-rotation.conf` inside the container; that path is unchanged. the file source in repo is moving directories only. runtime mount path in k8s manifest is still `mountPath: /etc/sidecar/conf`.

maria: ok then main risk is terraform replace causing a premature rollout during promote. can we gate the promote with a canary? for prod we should do overlay canary + manual promote. for staging i'm ok with a straight PR that merges now.

chris: also double-check any CI jobs that compute checksum from `overlays/staging/configs/` — if we have GH actions that expect the old path, they will fail. grep the repo for that path.

alex: i grepped: only two references, one in `deploy/scripts/generate-checksum.sh` (which reads by glob) and one in an old doc. i'll update the script to include new dir. will include the change in same PR to avoid CI flake.

priya: do we need a follow-up ticket to ensure the kustomize transformer is not path-sensitive? iirc there was an issue when patch targets used file references rather than inline patches.

alex: added a quick TODO in PR and a short test in `deploy/tests/kustomize-paths.test.sh` to validate patch apply for both old and new layout.

deploy-bot: CI: build 2442 passed — terraform plan: 1 to update, 0 to add, 0 to destroy. kubeval: no schema errors. :white_check_mark:

maria: perfect — if the PR includes the script update + test, i'm good to approve. leave prod promote gated until SRE can schedule canary window.

jenna: SRE: pinging @sre-oncall — we'll need a 15m canary window next Tue during low traffic if this goes prod after next deploy.

chris: nit: please add a short changelog line in `CHANGELOG.md` under `staging` so it's discoverable.

alex: done. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/512 — includes tf update, script tweak, test, and CHANGELOG entry. should be ready for review.

maria: reviewing now. thanks all :thumbsup:

priya: lgtm from infra scripting side, small comment on test timeout.

alex: pushed fix for timeout. last message: i'll merge once maria approves and then monitor staging deploy logs for the 10m after apply. i'll post results here.

alex: merged — staging apply completed, pods rotated, no errors in logs. canary window not needed for staging. monitoring for 30m.

maria: thanks for the walkthrough, closing the loop. feel free to schedule prod canary when SRE okays the window. :raised_hands:
